name: lib_list_exists_perm_isChain_of_total
statement: {α : Type} (r : α → α → Prop) (l : List α) (hnd : l.Nodup) (hl : ∀ a ∈ l, ∀ b ∈ l, a ≠ b → r a b ∨ r b a) : ∃ l' : List α, l'.Perm l ∧ List.IsChain r l'
closed: ∀ {α : Type} (r : α → α → Prop) (l : List α) (hnd : l.Nodup) (hl : ∀ a ∈ l, ∀ b ∈ l, a ≠ b → r a b ∨ r b a), ∃ l' : List α, l'.Perm l ∧ List.IsChain r l'
informal: Rédei's theorem in list form (every tournament has a Hamiltonian path): a duplicate-free list whose distinct elements are pairwise r-comparable can be permuted into an r-chain. Promoted from Mathlib2.comb_tournament_hamiltonian_path_aux2.
type: ∀ {α : Type} (r : α → α → Prop) (l : List α), l.Nodup → (∀ a ∈ l, ∀ b ∈ l, a ≠ b → r a b ∨ r b a) → ∃ l', l'.Perm l ∧ List.IsChain r l'
